newsitem.title: CHINA: China media says Beijing blast was homemade bomb.
newsitem.headline: China media says Beijing blast was homemade bomb.

text.p: An explosion that ripped through a bus in one of Beijing's busiest shopping districts was caused by a homemade bomb, officials of state-run Beijing Television said on Saturday.
One official said nobody was killed by the explosion aboard the Number 22 bus that rocked Beijing's western Xidan district at around 7.00 pm (1100 GMT) on Friday.
Chinese sources, however, said that at least two people were killed by the bomb, which prompted authorities in the capital to put police onto high alert.
The Beijing Television officials were confirming information already broadcast by the state media.

The bomb had been placed under seats three and four rows behind the driver of the articulated bus, one official said. "The police have asked the public to provide any information they have regarding this explosion," he said.
